                                       ORDINANCE                       DeCj.S/Z^-^l
      BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

        SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 7-F in the area bounded by

              a line 154.87 feet north of and parallel to West Barry Avenue;
              North Broadway; a line 122.33 feet north of and parallel to West
              Barry Avenue; and a line 200 feet west of and parallel to North
              Broadway

       to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District and a corresponding use district is
hereby established in the area above described.

       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.


       Address:      3120 to 3122 North Broadway Avenue, Chicago, Illinois
